history.summary: The best-supported referent for this generic CSV row is the Sri Venkateswara Swami Temple at Vaikuntapuram, on Vykuntapuram Road, Sangareddy (address: Vykuntapuram Rd, Sangareddy, Telangana 502294; phone +91 73299 26266; temple website svpd-srd.org; popular rating 4.7-4.8 across ~1,300 reviews). It is a colourful modern temple complex amid farmland with a pond and multiple statues, known for ladoo prasadam and annaprasadam; a SumanTV video describes it as housing a monumental statue of Lord Venkateswara (unverified). No reliable history, founding year or builder was found in any source - the full name 'Sri Mahalaxmi Goda Sametha Virat Venkateswara Swamy vari Divya kshetram' appears only in a locality listing. This is a GENERIC-NAME row: several other Venkateswara temples exist in the district (Veerabhadra Nagar, Sadasivpet, Patancheru, Mominpet), so if the CSV intends a different one it should be specified. CSV CORRECTION: town 'Sangareddy' refined to VAIKUNTAPURAM, on the outskirts of Sangareddy town. History details need verification.

name: Sri Venkateswara Swami Temple, Vaikuntapuram
town_description: Vaikuntapuram (Vykuntapuram) is a locality on the outskirts of Sangareddy town in Sangareddy district, Telangana, on Vykuntapuram Road. It is a semi-rural area with farmland around the temple; the Annnaprasada Satram (dining hall) serves devotees.

travel.road: On Vykuntapuram Road, a few km from Sangareddy town; reachable by local taxi/auto from Sangareddy.
